purpose: Compare incumbent repository guidance with explicitly named native context delivery modes under controlled, independently observable conditions.
generality: low-generality exploratory evaluation; one synthetic fixture and one bounded task do not support product-wide claims

modulo.status: not part of this exploratory experiment

context_types.artefact: arbitrary reference file, not automatically instructions
context_types.shadow_file: generated CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md-style fallback, materialised only after git-ignore preflight

A.label: incumbent_only
A.context_boundary: Frozen checkout with fixture-native AGENTS.md only.

B.label: incumbent_plus_native_shadow
B.context_boundary: Arm A plus a native AGENTS.md-style shadow file at the explicitly ignored destination.

C.label: native_scoped_rule
C.context_boundary: Arm A plus a path-scoped rule/materialisation only if OpenCode can consume it natively.

shadow_file_safety.preflight: record git check-ignore result before materialisation; refuse if unignored
shadow_file_safety.changed_file_guard: shadow file is allowed runtime/context materialisation and recorded separately
shadow_file_safety.cleanup: remove only when hash matches materialised hash

isolation.contamination_check: Verify parent checkout, checkout contents, shadow destination, session state and caches before and after every attempt.

task_and_scoring.primary_oracle: Fixed pytest oracle passes and changed-file scope is safe.
task_and_scoring.scoring_note: Valid task failures are scored; setup, provider, harness and contamination failures are excluded.

guardrails: no unsafe or out-of-scope file changes

validity.asymmetric_invalidity_rule: Invalidity asymmetry greater than 10 percentage points makes the experiment inconclusive.

exploratory_decision_thresholds.positive_signal: Continue only if Arm B improves primary correctness by at least 20 percentage points over Arm A across valid runs with no guardrail violation and overhead no more than 2x.
exploratory_decision_thresholds.no_signal: Difference within +/-20 percentage points with no guardrail regression.
exploratory_decision_thresholds.negative_signal: Arm B is at least 20 percentage points worse or shadow delivery causes a safety violation.
exploratory_decision_thresholds.inconclusive: Invalidity asymmetry exceeds 10 points, comparable runs are unavailable, or either valid arm has fewer than 4 valid runs.

causal_interpretation: Do not claim model consumption from arm assignment. Consumption is observed only when the harness boundary records it independently; otherwise report association only.

run_classification.valid_task_failure: Frozen task attempted, setup/provider valid, contamination and guardrails passed, oracle failed.
run_classification.valid_task_success: Frozen task attempted, provider outcome observed, contamination and guardrails passed, oracle passed.
run_classification.setup_invalidity: Fixture, checkout, protocol, permission, ignore preflight or command setup invalid.
run_classification.harness_invalidity: Harness could not produce a trustworthy record.
run_classification.provider_failure: OpenCode/provider/model could not produce a usable attempt.
run_classification.contamination_invalidity: Cross-arm, cache, output or parent contamination detected.
run_classification.unobserved: Relevant state was not independently observable.

records.result_format: JSONL, one immutable record per arm/attempt
records.secret_policy: Never write secret values, keys, tokens, credentials or raw environment dumps.
records.delivery_evidence: Record observed commit/diff/test and context-boundary evidence; claims are not evidence.

runner.stdin: always closed with subprocess.DEVNULL unless explicit prompt file redirect is used
runner.command: local OpenCode executable and arguments when available
runner.unavailable_provider_result: Record provider_failure or unobserved; never invent results.
runner.dry_run: Plans valid arms, materialisation, ignore preflight, isolation and command records without invoking OpenCode.
